title: Add Report Inbox API pages for automated report retrieval
summary: Four new API pages expose Report Inbox data through the 'automate' API group, allowing Power Platform and OData clients to discover and download scheduled report outputs across single or multiple companies.
key_points: Adds Report Inbox Items API page to list inbox entries
Adds Report Inbox Content API page to fetch report artifacts
Adds Report Inbox File API page to stream report artifacts
Adds Report Inbox Companies API page to list companies with inbox entries
Introduces three buffer tables to support the API pages
